entities.summary: Nunzio Nasi was an Italian liberal politician from Trapani, a long-serving deputy and twice a cabinet minister. He was at the centre of the caso Nasi (1904–07), a corruption case, and later joined the Aventine opposition to Fascism before losing his seat in 1926. He died in Erice in 1935.
